Cash, Arms Seized from Deceased Leader's Maharashtra Home

Police in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Maharashtra, conducted a raid at the residence of the late Baba Farzan, a former union leader. The operation uncovered a significant cache of cash, gold, silver, and thousands of bullets. The deceased had passed away six months prior to the raid due to illness.
